name: Do foreclosed houses usually need painting before they can be sold?
description: Usually, yes. Painting helps a foreclosed home look clean, cover damage, and improve buyer appeal after cleanup and repairs.

mainEntity.name: Do foreclosed houses usually need painting before they can be sold?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, foreclosed properties usually need painting after the interior is cleared and any damage is repaired. Fresh paint helps cover stains, smoke, scuffs, and odor-related discoloration so the home is ready for resale, rental, or a new owner walk-through.
